content: # Americium Dioxide (AmO2) in Nuclear Fuel Cycle Americium dioxide (AmO2) is a fluorite-structured actinide oxide with a lattice constant of 5.377 angstrom. The density is 11.68 g/cm^3. The melting point is approximately 2448 K. # Properties Relevant to Transmutation The thermal conductivity of AmO2 at 400 K is 3.8 W/(m K). The specific heat at 500 K is 0.240 J/(g K). Youngs modulus is approximately 170 GPa. The bulk modulus is 190 GPa. The band gap is approximately 1.4 eV.
